notes.title: Big update!
notes.notes:
https://i.imgur.com/eKzfwzT.jpg

New location for Survival Mode. The Circus. It's a hell of a fan. 

Chinese localization. Now it's full audio. 

Melee combat. We did the more comprehensible tutorial for that. 

Movie time! Now you can watch the story trailer for the game on the big screen in Chuck's van.

Sounds are normalized. 

Bugs fixed.
 The game doesn't stop at 10th or another wave anymore. 
 New locations are being achieved properly now. 
 Survival works properly. 
 Bug with an arrow blow after the tutorial is fixed. 
 Powerup tutorial improved. 
 The Tank doesn't 'glitch' anymore. 
 The Girl moves more smoothly. 
 Quick Zombie is animated (no pun intended). 
 The Wolf doesn't bite Chuck instantly if he misses a survivor. 
 Zombies don't go through the textures anymore. 
 Colliders in the Forest are fixed. 
 The arrow doesn't get stuck in another arrow anymore. 
 Japanese font works correctly now. 
 Minor bugs fixed.
